'''Scar''' is a map that is remade from the very first that {{player|alice|flag=se}} made when starting using map making programs, which was called '''Scarlet'''. This map is intended to keep the basic idea from the original, but polish and balance it. The map is very small, and is designed to be intense for 1on1 or 2on2. There is no quad placed on the map for 2on2. The layout is rather connected with teleports, to offer fast paced play. 

Location file is made by {{player|flintheart|flag=se}}
